stimulus.title: Hội thoại giữa hai đồng nghiệp
stimulus.audio_script:
Woman: Hi, Daniel. I just heard the printer on the second floor is broken again. Do you know if anyone has called the repair service?
Man: I called them this morning. Unfortunately, they said a technician can't come until Thursday.
Woman: Thursday? I need two hundred copies of the training manual for tomorrow's workshop.
Man: Why don't you use the copy center across the street? They're fast, and the company has an account there, so you won't have to pay for it yourself.
Woman: That's a great idea. I'll send them the file right now.

questions.stem_html: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.explain_html: Ngay câu đầu, người phụ nữ nói the printer on the second floor is broken again. Đáp án diễn đạt lại thành is not working, một kiểu paraphrase rất phổ biến ở Part 3.

questions.stem_html: According to the man, when will a technician come?
questions.explain_html: a technician can't come until Thursday, tức là sớm nhất thứ Năm. This morning là lúc anh ấy gọi điện (bẫy); tomorrow là ngày diễn ra workshop.

questions.stem_html: What will the woman most likely do next?

options.label: C
options.html: Send a file to a copy center

questions.explain_html: Câu hỏi do next thường có đáp án ở câu cuối: I'll send them the file right now, với them là copy center. Công ty đã có account nên (D) sai.
